# v0.1.26 preview

This artifact is a preview. It does not claim equivalence with other hosted
workflow services.

The version string is 0.1.26. The capability version is 12.

`worker --cap N` executes up to N accepted runs at once, with separate attempt
workspaces and container leases. The default is one. Concurrency groups,
cancellation, storage accounting, and shutdown apply across all execution
slots. A poll place's `cap` remains its queued-plus-running admission limit.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They are not
published. This change does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

No credentials are included in the artifact.
